added_failures_note: the reviewed run's baseline_suite and after_suite both record this node's neighbourhood gate with failure_count 1 and failure_ids ['tests/test_one_sprint_item_slug.py::test_consumers_share_the_one_reader'] at base 3eda1223d and head a63fd24dc, so the added set is empty and zero failures are attributable to this change.

findings.text: follow-on: the required-evidence extractor treats every whitespace-delimited token of the gate text as a candidate plan ref; measured over docs/plans it yields 894 tokens of which 871 are not slugs (bare numbers, capitalised words, HTML tag words), where the repository's own gate-ref reader confines gate text to a #stage-anchored ref, so a future prose word identical to a plan slug would silently silence a real unwired finding.

follow-on: gate_evidence_slugs_from_gates re-implements the gate-text plan-ref extraction that reckon/roadmap.py:228 _gate_section_refs already owns, without extending it and without its #stage discipline, so a gate's required_evidence is now parsed by two readers that agree today by coincidence rather than by construction.

follow-on: the plan's deliverable asks the audit message to name the two section-level forms beside the plan-level ones, but unwired_plan_message still reads only plan-depends-on, plan-blocks, plan-informs and gate, so a reader told a bare plan is unwired is not told a section wire silences it; the file was outside the node's declared write paths.

follow-on: the section_depends_on branch of the create-refusal section_wires input is exercised by no test (only the after branch is, at tests/test_section_relations_count_as_wiring.py:262), and the create ops path cannot set the key, so that half is untested pass-through.
